resources.string: Best-effort. Some Android TV devices restrict apps from launching automatically on boot; if it doesn’t start, open VONO manually.
Resume is handled by the VONO player. When ON, playback resumes after a restart if it was recently playing. When OFF, VONO starts without resuming.
Available outputs are shown above. Output selection (HDMI / Bluetooth / analog / speaker) is handled by the device operating system.
MASTER / CONTROL status is shown inside the player itself.
